model.substitution_reason: The default repository is gated and no Hugging Face credential is installed on CSAIL; the permitted Qwen3-8B snapshot is complete and its FFN width is compatible with both block controls.

data.document_separation: official train and validation splits; reject any exact article hash overlap

activation_sample.calibration_tail_stat_sampling: uniform stride over the 32K calibration stream
activation_sample.uniform_development_sampling: uniform stride over the 16K development stream

methods.name: perq_h32
methods.permutation: MassDiff block assignment with within-block descending calibration-p99 order

methods.name: perq_h128
methods.permutation: MassDiff block assignment with within-block descending calibration-p99 order

quantization.weight: symmetric signed narrow INT4 [-7,7], per output channel
quantization.activation: asymmetric unsigned INT4 [0,15], dynamic per token row
quantization.rounding: round to nearest, ties to even
quantization.zero_points: weight zero; activation rounded affine zero point clamped to [0,15]
quantization.weight_clipping_search: 21 linearly spaced max-absolute shrink factors from 1.00 through 0.80, independently selected per output channel by weight MSE
quantization.activation_clipping: dynamic observed row min/max; no extra percentile clipping
quantization.packing: two 4-bit values per byte; unpack is verified before dequantized reconstruction
quantization.weight_reconstruction: start from the original BF16 checkpoint weight for every method, apply the method basis, then independently clip, round, pack, unpack, and dequantize

metrics.primary_mean_output_error: sum squared output error divided by sum squared BF16-reference output on the uniform development rows
metrics.row_error: per-row squared output error divided by per-row squared reference norm plus 1e-12
metrics.tail_output_error: mean row_error over the highest-error 10 percent of uniform development rows
metrics.diagnostic_tail_reservoir: the same metrics on the separately selected activation-tail reservoir
metrics.large_activation_events: largest 0.1 percent absolute pre-transform entries in each retained sample
metrics.representative_coverage: event and row-maximum coverage for the first one and two p99-ranked lanes per MassDiff block
metrics.remaining_quality_gap: PeRQ block primary error minus full-Hadamard primary error, reported directly and relative to the identity-to-full improvement only when positive

next_experiment: Experiment A2 under the separate execution owner: measure the matched native rotation-quantize-pack-consumer and end-to-end baselines, then combine with A1 at Decision A.
